content:
This is too easy as a puzzle. Please re-create it as a clash of code (though I'm not sure whether similar clashes already exist).

Please also remember to format the line numbers in <<bold>>.

Thanks.

Stub generator
* If you intend to keep Reverse mode enabled, please remove Lines 5 to 14 from the stub generator.

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases which satisfy all the following conditions:

  • N = 100.

  • The values of [[count]] are randomly generated, and include one value of 1 and one value greater than 50.

  • The values of [[char]] cover a variety of characters, including lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits and other non-space ASCII characters.

  • Some [[char]] values appear more than once, but never in consecutive input lines.

Thanks.
